5634.title: [M158] Update SkiaSharp to Skia milestone 158
5634.body:
[M158] Update SkiaSharp to Skia milestone 158 (#5634)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/438
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5637
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/ce0fc683a40c6ba84d55072f31aa48d55c8f2131...f93fd1e432b85086477a6a1c21c1e560673d4a14

Adopt the m158 native engine as the 4.158 product line, keeping package,
assembly, native-library and governance identities consistent with the
selected Skia revision. Preserve the existing managed binding surface
while consuming the upstream engine update through the fork's C bridge.

~~ Pin the landed native merge without changing the reviewed tree ~~

Advance externals/skia from ce0fc683a40c6ba84d55072f31aa48d55c8f2131
to the actual mono/skia merge f93fd1e432b85086477a6a1c21c1e560673d4a14.
The native companion integrates chrome/m158 through
75584a96108b2bf0b1c74b0536126fa4917b64a8 while retaining the fork's
dependency policy, C bridge and platform compatibility adaptations.

The dependent repin in #5637 changes only the gitlink and matching
cgmanifest commitHash. The landed native commit has two parents and
directly includes reviewed b8af0ba51c9409bb2087e86a7461349c803b7170.
Both native commits have tree 435f794aa44e8ff7902239fdf24913783eda4837,
so recording the landed SHA does not substitute different native source
for the reviewed and built source.

The producing sync reports a passing Linux x64 native source build,
managed binding build and unfiltered console solution. Binding
regeneration reported no generated changes; this parent diff changes no
managed wrappers, generated bindings or C API declarations.

~~ Keep the 4.158 package line and native identity synchronized ~~

Change the Skia release and libSkiaSharp milestone from 157 to 158.
Keep the C API increment at zero and set the native SONAME to 158.0.0:
the milestone changes even though this update adds no C bridge exports.

Advance the SkiaSharp assembly/file version to 4.158.0.0 and the
SkiaSharp-family NuGet rows in VERSIONS.txt to 4.158.0. Set the Azure
SKIASHARP_VERSION variable to the same numeric package version so CI
does not identify the new milestone's packages as the previous line.
These are source version inputs, not a declaration that packages have
been published.

~~ Reserve the next HarfBuzzSharp milestone revision bucket ~~

Keep native HarfBuzz at 14.4.0, its SONAME at 0.61440.0 and the
HarfBuzzSharp assembly version at 1.0.0.0. Advance its file and NuGet
versions from 14.4.0.200 to 14.4.0.300.

The version policy reserves 100 revision values per Skia milestone
while the native HarfBuzz version stays unchanged. Moving to the next
bucket distinguishes the m158 package set without implying a native
HarfBuzz upgrade or consuming the previous milestone's servicing range.

~~ Record the exact upstream and Vulkan-Headers governance identities ~~

Update the Skia governance entry from chrome/m157 to chrome/m158 and
record upstream revision 75584a96108b2bf0b1c74b0536126fa4917b64a8.
Keep that upstream identity distinct from the mono/skia fork merge:
the git registration and submodule both use the actual landed fork SHA.

The native update advances Vulkan-Headers from 1.4.365 to 1.4.366.
Record revision 73814d006638aa00bd553215b054f0f02e457e22 in the
dependency registration, reviewed-identity URL and header-version source.
This keeps the manifest's version and revision evidence aligned with the
selected native DEPS pin rather than retaining the previous header
identity after the engine update.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>

5626.title: Fix Skia sync release routing and native base starting point
5626.body:
* Fix Skia sync release routing and native base starting point

Route same-milestone servicing syncs and explicit release-line overrides to the
paired release branches, start the native merge from the live base tip instead of
a lagging parent gitlink, and stop publication when a base advances mid-run.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Infer target from release override; require release milestone match

5620.title: Detect incomplete NuGet shipments in release audits
5620.body:
* Detect incomplete NuGet shipments in release audits

Check each shipment's source-controlled shipping package IDs and exact family versions, discover publication without the SkiaSharp anchor, and block Finish and replacement cuts until publication is complete. Reuse the completeness guard in Finish and expose missing versus unavailable evidence.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Keep publication documentation focused on operator guidance

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Use exact shipping inputs for historical package inventories

Exclude version rows whose projects were not yet included in the shipment's pack filter. Cover project inclusion changes with a committed-source fixture, so a newer VERSIONS entry does not falsely mark an older shipment partial.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Use tracked solution-filter casing in publishing tests

Match SkiaSharpSource.Windows.slnf so the inventory assertion also runs on case-sensitive Linux filesystems.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Keep intermediate unpublished stable cuts visible in release reports

Show the latest complete shipment alongside partial publication and retain older missing stable cuts for review without changing release action gates.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Add task-focused release audit checks and milestone ranges

Select Upstream, Prepare, Finish, or NuGet without fetching unrelated checks. Keep the full audit as the default and retain all prerequisite gates for Prepare. Expand inclusive same-major ranges, preserve per-line failures, and distinguish unchecked facts from healthy results.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Assert Finish reporting independently of console table wrapping

Use the explicit release-action field instead of relying on a host-specific table row layout.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Trim release audit documentation to usage and safety requirements

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
